source: trip-planner model, not measured traffic: keyless engines (Valhalla, OSRM) have no historical speeds (tested 2026-10-10, same time at 03:00, 08:00 and 17:30), so free-flow time is calibrated and then scaled by time of day; trip_hubs.py reads these rows too (typical for rides, plan for --access car). https://valhalla.github.io/valhalla/api/route/api-reference/
note: factors multiply free-flow time per route chunk, chosen by the clock time the chunk is driven and whether it is on the 407 ETR, inside a congested area or elsewhere; plan is a conservative planning allowance (modelled, not a measured on-time rate)

calibration.note: keyless free-flow times are slower than real free-flow on the 407 ETR and on highways outside cities (Valhalla 407 about 91 km/h, OSRM 407 about 79 km/h, OSRM scales posted speeds by 0.8); multiply chunk free-flow time before the time-of-day factor. GTHA chunks off the 407 stay at 1.0 (they already match Google). Not applied to TomTom (live times).
calibration.osrm_note: OSRM rural highway factor is an estimate from the car profile (no Google pair checked); low confidence
calibration.reference: Google Maps typical ranges checked 2026-10-10 from south Milton: Markham Wed 07:30 via 407 40 to 60 min, avoid tolls 60 to 120 min; Canada's Wonderland Sat 11:00 via 407 35 to 50 min, avoid tolls 45 to 75 min; Tobermory Sat 07:00 avoid tolls 210 to 250 min; Blue Mountain Sat 08:00 110 to 140 min; Kingston Fri 15:00 via 407 and 401 170 to 230 min, 401 only 200 to 300 min; Detroit Tue 09:00 via 401 190 to 250 min. Pinned in tests/test_drive_route.py (Calibration)

etr407_note: the 407 ETR is congestion-priced and runs near free flow at rush hour, so it gets its own rows instead of the GTHA congested rows

getaway.extra_mondays_note: Easter Monday and Civic Holiday: long-weekend returns, not ESA holidays, so the 407 still prices them as weekdays; used only for the returning getaway
getaway.note: applies outside congested areas only: leaving the GTHA (origin inside, destination outside) or returning into it

tomtom_plan.note: TomTom times already include traffic; typical = TomTom time, plan multiplier per chunk (congested peak, congested daytime, night or elsewhere); 407 ETR chunks use other
